en.headline: MTR chief says contractor performance on Tung Chung West columns is unacceptable
en.dek: Jacob Kam said the company is following up seriously with the contractor on the unfinished concrete columns and that the target opening time remains unchanged for now.
body: MTR Corporation chief executive Jacob Kam said the company was following up seriously with the contractor after more than 30 concrete columns at the Tung Chung West station platform were found not to have been properly completed to the top.

Kam described the situation as unacceptable and said the priority was for the contractor to explain what happened and complete remedial works as soon as possible. He added that the target opening time for the station had not changed for the moment, subject to how the columns are fixed.

The Buildings Department previously said about 30 columns showed construction deficiencies but did not pose an immediate structural danger while temporary supports remain in place. The Highways Department has required a detailed report.

zh.headline: 楊美珍指東涌西站柱問題不可接受 開通目標暫不變
zh.dek: 港鐵行政總裁楊美珍表示，已嚴肅跟進承辦商就30多條混凝土柱未到頂的問題，當務之急是盡快查明原因及完成修復，目標開通時間暫時不變。
body: 港鐵公司行政總裁楊美珍表示，東涌西站月台層發現30多條混凝土柱未到頂，公司正與承辦商嚴肅跟進，形容情況不可接受。
她說當務之急是要求承辦商盡快說明原因及如何補救，並盡快完成修復工作。至於整個東涌西站工程進度，她表示要視乎如何修復柱柱，但目標開通時間暫時不會改變。
屋宇署早前表示約30條混凝土柱施工欠妥，由於臨時支撑尚未拆除，情況不構成即時結構危險。路政署已要求港鐵提交詳細報告。
